final_test_general_feedback: Participants made no specific comments; all three said that, overall, the system worked well.

statements.name: Mengdigerey Zhanzhol
statements.role: Accounts, notices, photos, security and backup
statements.text: I built the account and notice workflow: local registration and sign-in, publishing and editing notices, the single-photo upload, owner and administrator permissions, and the full backup with restore check. My files are Campus_Lost_Found/app.py, templates/form.html, backup_full.py and backup_tools.py. Commits a7e5c74, ca5d0e5 and 4d91abd were pushed from my GitHub account, zondbebox. One problem I solved: the backup writer and the restore reader used different size limits for the manifest file, so a backup could be created that restore would then refuse. I made both use one shared 1 MiB limit and added three regression tests. Next time I would commit every feature separately, so the history shows who built what.

statements.name: Galitskiy Daniil
statements.role: Browsing and search, performance, SQL analytics, user study
statements.text: I was responsible for browsing and search, the search performance test, the SQL analytics and the user-testing method. My files are Campus_Lost_Found/analytics_routes.py, backend/analytics.py, Analysis/01-03 SQL queries, benchmark_search.py, the research timer in stage2_features.py and Testing/TASK_CARDS_EN.txt. They are in commit a7e5c74, and I am a co-author of the Final commits ca5d0e5 and 4d91abd. One problem I solved: very large numbers in the category and page filters crashed SQLite with an overflow error. I added range checks that return HTTP 400 or 404 before any query runs, plus four regression tests. Next time I would run the external user study weeks earlier, not at the end.

statements.name: Bisengaliev Daulet
statements.role: Smart-locker simulation, multimedia, mobile and availability evidence
statements.text: I worked on the smart-locker extension, the multimedia and the 360 px, keyboard and availability evidence. My files are the locker part of Campus_Lost_Found/stage2_features.py, static/locker.js, static/locker.css, templates/smart_locker.html, simulate_locker.py, static/media/CREDITS.txt and the Assignment 4 video. They are in commit a7e5c74, and I am a co-author of the Final commits ca5d0e5 and 4d91abd. One problem I solved: when the found notice linked to an open locker was deleted, the simulation could not be closed. I added a reset action that records a new closed, unassigned state and keeps the history. Next time I would test on a real phone early and re-record the video after every interface change.
